neighbours.label: the token right before a 9 that the text makes predictable, in two ways: a number being copied from earlier in the text (on the token before its 9), and a counting run in digits or words whose next item is 9 ('… eight,'); copies with a different digit there, and counting runs whose next item is another number, stay quiet
fire:
Your table number is 193.
The waiter called table 19
Gate 39 is closing. Final call for gate 3
Serial 5193 was logged. Logged again: serial 519
Dial extension 1395, and if busy, dial 13
The children shouted together: five, six, seven, eight,
She counted the steps out loud, six, seven, eight,
quiet:
Your table number is 123.
The waiter called table 12
Gate 32 is closing. Final call for gate 3
Serial 5123 was logged. Logged again: serial 512
Dial extension 1395 for the front desk, please.

neighbours.notes: Found in the copy-only digit screen, then probed: copy before a 9 0.36, counting to nine in words 0.45, in digits 0.19; copy with another digit 0.02, a count past 9 0.07. The same two-route profile as the held predictable-3, -6 and -8 units at layer 35 (L35/N6726-, L35/N1376+, L35/N7741-); those have copy-only feeders at layer 34.

predictions: >= 6/8 fire (counting in digits may be weaker); near misses < 0.2
